description.value: You can tell which way a radiation plume is drifting from the way the ash moves, before any counter clicks. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks made to predict or avoid hazardous weather caused by radiation or fallout.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 Survival bonus targets the Predict Weather activity, which itself ships with no rule-element representation in real pf2e (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/skill/level-2/predict-weather.json ships rules: [] and sets no discoverable 'action:predict-weather' roll option) -- there is nothing to predicate on that would ever actually fire.
